proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item payload family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. The TAXONOMY has magic_item_root as a v4 source atom, but types.ts defines no corresponding record shape or mechanics family. Any honest encoding of Iron Bands (or any magic item) requires this structural addition first.
proposed_widenings.evidence: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — magic_item is absent.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: 'restrained'
proposed_widenings.justification: Iron Bands applies the Restrained condition on a hit. The Condition type currently only includes 'prone', which was added for Topple mastery. Restrained is a distinct SRD condition with different mechanical consequences.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target has the Restrained condition until you take a Bonus Action to issue a command that releases it.

proposed_widenings.name: AttackKind: 'ranged_weapon_attack' (non-spell)
proposed_widenings.justification: Iron Bands uses a ranged attack roll with Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus — the same formula as a ranged weapon attack, not a spell attack roll. AttackKind only covers ranged_spell_attack and melee_spell_attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Make a ranged attack roll with an attack bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: 'dawn'
proposed_widenings.justification: Iron Bands recharges at the next dawn, which is a distinct cadence not expressible by short_rest, long_rest, short_or_long_rest, or partial_short_full_long.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once the bands are used, they can't be used again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase or resolution: 'ability_check'
proposed_widenings.justification: A creature touching the bands can take an Action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to break free. This is an ability_check resolution (v4 taxonomy has the atom, but it is absent from the surface ActivationPhase discriminated union).
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that can touch the bands, including the one Restrained, can take an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to break the iron bands.

proposed_widenings.name: item_destroy (or 'destroy_item' effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful Athletics check the iron bands are destroyed. No v4 effect atom covers item self-destruction as a mechanical outcome. The closest atoms (alter_item_kind, fall_on_end) do not cover this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful check, the item is destroyed, and the Restrained creature is freed.

proposed_widenings.name: Automatic-failure state on ability check (repeated-failure lock)
proposed_widenings.justification: After a failed break-free attempt, further attempts by that creature automatically fail for 24 hours. This is a stateful cooldown on an ability-check attempt that has no analog in the current atom inventory.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed check, any further attempts made by that creature automatically fail until 24 hours have elapsed.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no MagicItemRecord exists in UnitRecord. Even if the record type were added, Iron Bands would require at minimum: a non-spell ranged attack kind, the restrained condition, a dawn reset cadence, an ability_check resolution on the surface (not just in v4 taxonomy), an item-destruction effect, and a repeated-failure-lock state. The secondary release mechanic (Bonus Action command to free the restrained creature) could potentially compose from existing atoms (bonus_action_quota + apply_condition removal), but the other gaps are all genuine widenings.
